formulas.formula: Plan the whole year, track every month, finish 2027 ahead.
Setup: your name and the year (2027 is set for you).
Income Plan: each paycheck or income with how often it comes. Expense Plan: each category with an amount and how often.
Yearly, quarterly and one-time items need a month. Weekly and every-2-weeks are spread across months for you.
Transactions: log real income and spending all year.
Monthly and Categories: plan vs actual. Dashboard: the whole year at a glance. Goals: your big targets.
26 paychecks a year. Two months get a third check, so the plan spreads them evenly.
A common guide is 50 / 30 / 20 of take-home pay.
Put savings in the Expense Plan as a Savings line so it gets planned.
Categories compares spending with the plan so far, not the whole year.
Here's to your best money year yet.

section_bars.label: SPENDING: PLAN VS ACTUAL BY MONTH
